mathematical_properties.loss_function_alignment: Log-transformation compresses heavy-tailed degradation spikes; naive exponential inversion preserves the conditional geometric median (50 ms), the Bayes-optimal point predictor for L1 MAE loss.
mathematical_properties.jensen_inequality_proof: Applying Jensen's inequality correction factor exp(z + 0.5*sigma^2) shifts the prediction to the conditional mean (~100 ms), inflating MAE by >18 ms.
